title: Social structure and roles within the tribe
summary: The chief formed the tribe, spy boys are younger, there is a wild man; spy boys scout for other tribes and the flag boy signals.

blocks.x: Do we find... I just lost the question. Where is it? A reason... I can't think of the... It was in my head and now it's gone. The reasoning for their formation is that... We said it was for a good time. Do you find a social structure in the organization of the tribes?

There seems to be a social structure. I'm unable to analyze it really. The chief is probably the fellow who formed the tribe and what he'd call himself the second chief would be his best friend. And then they go down. The spy boys are usually much younger and recently came into the tribe. And there's another one that we haven't mentioned is... And all of them have it is the wild man, which is a connotation of the medicine man. He dresses up with either a skull and horns and so forth.
Are these just titles which are given? Do they actually have functional work that they do during the year?

They... The title is more or less given. But the spy boys go down and they do have a function. They go down to the corner to see if any other tribes are coming. The flag boy signals. They have... There's a lot of intricacy there.
